title: Text size is 0.7 em (H of Lato Bold at size 20 is 20.6 mm)
description: H in Lato Bold at size 20 mm: the height of its stitches shows what the size measures. PE-DESIGN's size is 0.7 em, so Lato Bold's H is 1.033 x size.

evidence.note: docs/COMPATIBILITY_AUDIT.md, Next 11: line spacing / text-size basis

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page (File > New), with Lato Bold (crates/openstitch-design/fonts/Lato-Bold.ttf, OFL) installed for the current Windows user and used as a TrueType font. Add the text H, size 20.0 mm, colour 800 RED, region Fill Stitch at its defaults, line Not Sewn, alignment default. Save As PES (default type) as compat/reference/text/text-size-h.pes and record in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json the PE-DESIGN version, date, OS, the font as PE lists it, every Text Attributes value and every setting you changed (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/text/text-size-h.pes: H at size 20 is 20.6 mm tall (size = 0.7 em; Lato Bold's capitals are 1446/2000 em, 1.033 x size). Replaces the cap-height hypothesis (20.0).
